svg.aria-label: Isometric console, sketch B: instrument deck
svg.title: Isometric console, sketch B: instrument deck

g.text: Long low deck, raised control module, stepped isotherm disc inside a Tj scale bezel.
Six posterised isotherm bands from heat scale;
% of rated (1000 A). Red arc + engraved value.
Runs along the module; fan_failure / clogging
Heat-scale fill; fault is a dashed outline.
Status word printed for the hottest.
